hypotheses.falsified_if: No complete pair changes its verified top-3 set or decision, or the change rate is below the declared 20% criterion.
hypotheses.label: hypothesis
hypotheses.statement: Enriched audit verification (2 finalists + 4 audit) changes the verified rank/decision relative to the current 4+2 allocation on crease__core_law_v4 at equal verify cost.

hypotheses.falsified_if: Enriched audit changes the verified top-3 set or decision in at least 20% of complete pairs.
hypotheses.label: hypothesis
hypotheses.statement: The two verification allocations agree; the extra audit samples add no decision-relevant information at this budget.

practical_improvement.criterion: Enriched audit changes the verified top-3 set or the accept/reject decision in at least 20% of complete pairs, or reduces the mean absolute rank shift of the screened top-3 by at least one position, with no increase in new BEM calls.
practical_improvement.label: declared_practical_threshold_not_a_speedup_claim
practical_improvement.rationale: A verification allocation is decision support, not an optimizer.  The criterion asks whether the extra audit samples change a decision; it is a declared pilot criterion, not a promise of superiority.

analysis_plan.primary_endpoint: Verified top-3 rank agreement and the recorded accept/reject decision under the two verification allocations at equal six-call verify cost.

results_parser.censoring: Right-censored at the declared budget/attempt cap; censored pairs remain in the denominator and are never counted as reached.
results_parser.note: A solver failure, a cheap pre-BEM refusal and an unclassified row are distinct outcomes.  None becomes J=1000 or a silent pass.
results_parser.verify_calls: Reported separately when mode=verify is recorded; otherwise null with verify_calls_unknown=true.

analysis_plan.stopping_rule: Predeclared paired analysis by seed index: report the proportion of complete pairs whose verified top-3 set or decision changes, the mean absolute rank shift, and a bootstrap 95% CI with right-censoring at the six-call verify budget.  Fewer than five complete pairs is pilot_only, not a significance guarantee.

arms.label: current allocation: up to 4 finalists + 2 audit verify calls

verification.selection_rule: Up to four distinct screen finalists by frozen J, then two uniformly selected remaining eligible screened designs from the reserved audit RNG seed; no duplicates or already-verified specs.

arms.config_overlay_note: Existing config-schema keys only.  Verification allocation is a study policy, not a config default; it is not written into examples/.
arms.label: enriched audit: 2 finalists + 4 audit verify calls

verification.selection_rule: Up to two distinct screen finalists by frozen J, then four uniformly selected remaining eligible screened designs from the reserved audit RNG seed; no duplicates or already-verified specs.

cost_accounting.note: The enriched-audit arm spends the same six verify calls as the current arm; a larger verify budget would be a new revision.  Attempts, retries and unknown reservations are accounted exactly as in pilot 1.

per_arm_per_replicate.screen_semantics: search.budget_counts: valid means the 18 budget units count VALID screen evaluations; deterministic refusals consume the 120-attempt cap, not the 18-valid budget.

replication_aggregate.note: Arithmetic expansion of the 25-seed paired schedule.  This aggregate is a planning figure only; no execution is authorized by this manifest.

cpu_if_beat_cpu.rule: If the owner selects beat_cpu, the study runner must explicitly hold runs/.cpu.lane.lock.  The current CLI _solve_lock is a null context for CPU because the night runner owns the CPU lock.  gpu-clean and night hygiene must not touch hosts of a lane whose lock is live.

gpu.note: The study runner must own the GPU lock for the full serial run.  Never clean hosts from another or an unknown lane.

no_default_changes.statement: No default, objective version, score tolerance/weight, registration, cache/dataset or GUI/CLI change is made or implied.  This is a prepare-only scratch manifest; overlays are not applied.

notes: This is a second physical task, not a second copy of pilot 1.  It shares the brief/scoring family but has different geometry/bounds and more searched knobs. Results are never pooled with native__ath_core_v4.  The overlay is never applied by this tool.
question: Hypothesis (not a claim): on crease__core_law_v4, an enriched audit verification allocation (2 finalists + 4 audit) changes the verified top-3 rank or the accept/reject decision relative to the current 4-finalist + 2-audit allocation at the same six verify calls.  No speedup or improvement is promised.

pairing.difference_definition: d = A - B (negative => A has lower J / is better)
pairing.note: Pair seed 5201 in the current-allocation arm with seed 5201 in the enriched-audit arm, etc.  A shared CMA seed is not proof of shared candidates; pairing is valid only because it is predeclared.  Pilot 2 uses its own 5201-5225 schedule; 5101-5125 is reserved for pilot 1.

run_order.note: Alternate allocation order by seed index (odd current-first, even enriched-first) or predeclare a fixed random permutation before the first dispatch and record it.  Never run the two arms concurrently: the GPU lane is serial.

fail_or_no_gain_rollback: Preparing or validating this manifest changes no production default, objective version, tolerance/weight, cache/dataset behavior, GUI/CLI behavior or registration.
If the pilot is not scheduled, discard the scratch overlay; no live file was written.
If enriched audit adds no decision-relevant information, keep the current 4-finalist + 2-audit allocation.
If enriched audit changes a decision but the change is not supported by measured verified evidence, do not adopt it.
If the comparison is inconclusive, do not silently enlarge the verify budget; a larger audit is a new revision.
A cancellation or crash preserves partial results; unknown attempts are reconciled, never relaunched automatically.

owner_adoption_decisions.adopt_if: Prospective paired evidence meets the declared decision-change criterion with no increase in new-BEM cost.
owner_adoption_decisions.decision: Adopt enriched 2-finalist + 4-audit verification for this task family

owner_adoption_decisions.adopt_if: Enriched audit does not meet the decision-change criterion.
owner_adoption_decisions.decision: Keep the protocol verification policy unchanged
owner_adoption_decisions.otherwise: If adopted, prepare a separately reviewed policy revision; do not flip a default.

owner_adoption_decisions.adopt_if: Pilot variability supports a power plan at the declared criterion.
owner_adoption_decisions.otherwise: Stop at the pilot; no budget creep or silent criterion change.

block_estimate.basis: 18 valid screen BEM calls + 6 verify calls; the measured run had 162 valid screen rows in 200 attempts (38 cheap refusals, ~19% refusal rate), so reaching 18 valid evaluations is expected to take about 22 attempts. Verify fidelity (1024 balloon points) has no measured timing; the range assumes 1x-2x the screen per-BEM cost.

caveats: Measured on one historical crease__core_law_v4 screen run (2026-10-27), not on this pilot; host/cache state is not controlled and there is no timing spread estimate.
The measured run's wall_span is 28,125 s because of pauses; use its accumulated candidate cost (~4,399 s), not wall span.
Verify-fidelity cost is unmeasured; the 1x-2x multiplier is an assumption, not a measurement.
The ~19% cheap-refusal rate is task-specific; a different candidate pool may change the attempt count.
Arithmetic extrapolation only; not a speedup claim.  Real scheduling uses owner availability and a required deadline.
runtime_estimates.method: Measured S3-style cost ledger of a local crease__core_law_v4 screen run, then arithmetic extrapolation to the declared 24-call block.  No speedup is claimed.

budget.rule: Stop dispatching at 24 new BEM calls or 120 new attempts for an arm/seed block, whichever comes first; preserve partial results and the attempt journal.

cancellation.rule: An explicit cancellation stops future dispatch, cancels only the owned lane/process tree, and preserves partial results.  CPU analysis/proposal work never invokes GPU cleanup.

deadline.rule: A wall deadline must be chosen from comparable measured logs and owner availability before real scheduling.  This prepared manifest leaves the deadline as an explicit placeholder.

infrastructure_failures.rule: Stop after three consecutive infrastructure/solver-host failures; an unknown in-flight attempt retains its reservation and is reconciled, not relaunched automatically.

pool_exhaustion.rule: If the legal candidate pool has no novel candidate after the declared retries, stop with pool_exhausted; do not widen bounds or fabricate a design.

stale_package.rule: Stop if the manifest revision/config hash no longer matches the approved package; a resumed package reconciles all prior attempts first.

cohort.note: The S0 primary screen group contains native__ath_core_v4, atlas__ath_core, atlas__core_law and crease__core_law_v4 at the same grid/dependency/target hash.  The census reports pooled group counts (1,499 complete replayable rows), not a config-specific count for crease.
